SELECT COUNT(*) FROM GE_MP_FRMID_M A JOIN GE_MP_FRM_M B ON A.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL = B.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL AND B.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL = #{FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL}
AND A.TITL_NM LIKE '%'||#{TITL_NM}||'%'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO GE_MP_FRMID_M ( FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL, FRM_ID, TITL_NM, TH1_ITM_NM, TH2_ITM_NM, TH3_ITM_NM, STDVL_VAL_NM, UNIT_NM, CNIF_YN, CNIF_TAG_NM, REGPR_ID, REGPR_NM, RG_DT ) VALUES ( #{FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL}, #{FRM_ID}, #{TITL_NM}, #{TH1_ITM_NM}, #{TH2_ITM_NM}, #{TH3_ITM_NM}, #{STDVL_VAL_NM}, #{UNIT_NM}, #{CNIF_YN}, #{CNIF_TAG_NM}, #{REGPR_ID}, #{REGPR_NM}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE GE_MP_FRMID_M SET TITL_NM = #{TITL_NM}, TH1_ITM_NM = #{TH1_ITM_NM}, TH2_ITM_NM = #{TH2_ITM_NM}, TH3_ITM_NM = #{TH3_ITM_NM}, STDVL_VAL_NM = #{STDVL_VAL_NM}, UNIT_NM = #{UNIT_NM}, CNIF_YN = #{CNIF_YN}, CNIF_TAG_NM = #{CNIF_TAG_NM} WHERE FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL = #{FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL} AND FRM_ID = #{FRM_ID}
mapper.select: SELECT A.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL, A.FRM_ID, C.PRCDOC_NO, C.PRCDOC_NM, A.TITL_NM, A.TH1_ITM_NM, A.TH2_ITM_NM, A.TH3_ITM_NM, A.STDVL_VAL_NM, A.UNIT_NM, A.CNIF_YN, CASE WHEN A.CNIF_YN = 'Y' THEN '연계' WHEN A.CNIF_YN = 'N' THEN '미연계' ELSE '' END AS FM_CNIF_YN, A.CNIF_TAG_NM, A.REGPR_ID, A.REGPR_NM, A.RG_DT, TO_CHAR(A.RG_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS FM_RG_DT FROM GE_MP_FRMID_M A JOIN GE_MP_FRM_M B ON A.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL = B.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL AND B.FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL = #{FRM_UNQ_KY_VAL} JOIN GE_MP_PRCDOC_M C ON B.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL = C.PRCDOC_UNQ_KY_VAL WHERE A.FRM_ID = #{FRM_ID}
